english:
Does not work with a <stasis Stasis /> or <strand Strand /> Super equipped.

Scoring 2 Powered Melee Kills or performing a Finisher spawns an Elemental Pickup matching your equipped Light Super. The Powered Melee Kills must be at least approximately 0.2 seconds apart.

source.text:
2 Piece | Lucent Transmutation

Upon scoring 2 Powered Melee Kills or a finisher:
Generates a Light-Subclass Super-Matching Elemental Pickup.
Does nothing while a Stasis or Strand Super is equipped. Kills must be spaced out by at least ~0.2 seconds.
